entities.summary: Sergio Gor is an American businessman and political operative who has served as the United States ambassador to India since 2026. Gor has additionally served as the United States special envoy for South and Central Asian affairs since August 2025. He was previously the director of the White House Presidential Personnel Office from January to October 2025.
